description: Task Engine lifecycle event type 'taskDeadLettered'. Published when a task is moved to its configured dead-letter queue. Derived from the Event Broker base event type; routed to the task_events topic and partitioned by subject (the task ID) for per-task ordering.

type.$comment: Pins the event-type identifier so an editor can validate a payload against this schema alone.

resource_refs.description: The task's resource references (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-resource-refs), carried on task-scoped events so consumers can route per resource without a read-back.

resource_type.description: GTS type identifier of the referenced resource.

verified.description: True only if a creator check of the task type confirmed, at creation, that the creator may act on this resource (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-resource-refs). False means the reference is the creator's unverified claim; consumers MUST NOT treat it as proof of access.

actor.description: Authenticated subject whose API or worker call caused this event. Absent when the engine itself caused it (timer, lease scan, retention, cascade from another task).

dead_letter_queue.description: Queue the task was dead-lettered into.

result_code.description: Terminal result code recorded at dead-lettering.
